gain_on_divestment_basis: Disclosed at valuation: purchase consideration JPY52.0 billion was 'in line with' (equal to) JLL Morii Valuation & Advisory K.K.'s independent valuation of JPY52.0 billion as at 30 April 2023 => 0% premium/discount.
